question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(3)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "highly".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"highly"** means to a great degree or extent; extremely. (बहुत अधिक)

 
 
• **Example: **She is highly skilled in computer programming.
 
 
 
• In this context, it is said that Measles is an extremely contagious virus.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word for the blank is **'highly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "highly".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mutant **(उत्परिवर्ती): An organism or a new genetic character arising or resulting from an instance of mutation.

 
 
• **Example:** The mutant gene caused an abnormality in the fruit fly.
 
 
 
• **Partially **(आंशिक रूप से): To some extent; not completely.
 
 
• **Example: **He was only partially responsible for the accident.
 
 
 
• **Great** (महान): Of an extent, amount, or intensity considerably above the normal or average.
 
 
• **Example:** The concert was a great success with a huge turnout.
